summary: Online Brands Nordic AB (publ) engages in the online sale of carpets under Trendcarpet brand. It operates through Retail of Home Furnishings; Retail of Apparel; Retail of Outdoor Recreation and Camping; Retail of Beauty and Cosmetics; Jewelry Retail; and Other segments. The company offers kitchen equipment through online and its stores under Kitchenlab brand; and camping and outdoor equipment under GetCamping brand name, as well as offers seeds within cultivation and garden accessories through the online store. In addition, it develops and sells basic garments for women and men through e-commerce and external retailers under Bread & Boxers brand; and designs, manufactures, and sells outdoor and ski clothing for children and youth under Isbjörn brand. Further, the company sells jewelry and silverware under Victorins brand, as well as sells furniture and home furnishings. Online Brands Nordic AB (publ) was founded in 1981 and is based in Hisings Backa, Sweden.
